title: PanLink — claimed by thegentlemen
description:
SE · Technology · panlink.se PanLink AB is a Swedish contract manufacturer of cable harnesses, modules and complete assemblies, org.nr 556541-5295, Malmö, since April 1997.
It is wholly owned by the Fairford Holdings group, bought in 2006; the ultimate owner is the Osseiran family.
